passives.name: Adept Arts
passives.description: Skills are enhanced based on Adept Arts level. Landing combo finishers raises Arts level, and the level resets shortly after a skill is activated.

passives.name: Adrenaline Rush
passives.description: Greatly increases Power Raise's charge speed when charged immediately after a combo finisher.
